limitations: This collection covers Compliance and Exemption cell circulars on exemption and relaxation of establishments under section 17 (2008-2026): grant guidelines, EDLI exemption, compliance audit, surcharge, online returns of exempted establishments, cancellation and surrender, transfer of past accumulation, the 2023-2024 SOPs and the 2026 amnesty. Meeting minutes, RTI replies, lists of establishments, court-case reports, MIS-105 returns and committee reconstitutions are not included.

The 28 December 2007 comprehensive guideline on exemption, which the 2011 and 2016 circulars say they amend, is not in the mirror and is not in this collection; the 2023 SOP's annexure lists it among the circulars it supersedes.

The SOPs of 22 August 2023 (grant), 6 October 2023 (management and regulation) and 13 August 2024 (surrender) state that they supersede all earlier instructions and circulars and annex a list of them; each listed circular that is in this collection is linked by a supersession read from the annexure (the annexure marks each circular's provisions as same, modified or deleted in the SOP, which is not recorded here). Circulars of 2008 to 2015 on compliance audit, minutes and other matters that are not in the annexure are not stated to be superseded.

The 2023-2024 SOPs state no commencement date other than their issue date. The 2026 circulars (monthly review of Regional Offices on exemption matters, 10 July 2026; AMNESTY 2026, 11 July 2026) and the 2025 circulars on past accumulations of non-UAN members and on EDLI exemption applications state no commencement date in the passages checked; AMNESTY 2026 states that it is valid up to 28 December 2026 unless extended.
Several circulars before 2012 were issued only to zones or regions and refer to Income Tax recognition rules since changed; the effect of later changes in tax law is not assessed.

Transfer of securities and past accumulations on cancellation of exemption and the Pattern of Investment 2015 for exempted trusts (Finance) are included from 2015; the Finance circulars before 2015 and the Investment Pattern of 2003 are not. EDLI exemption circulars issued by the Pension Division (2017-2022) are included; the 2009 Gazette notification on investment pattern is not included because its first page is a Gazette notification, not an EPFO circular.
Dates follow the letter, not the issuer listing; entries whose letter date differs carry a date_note.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
